messages:
anya: Heads-up — I'm trying to correlate recent role changes with sudden route quota spikes in the per-route dashboard. Anyone got a reliable telemetry query or event name we already use? :thinking:

sam: We currently emit separate events: `role_change` and `quota_usage`. Joining them works but it's noisy at high throughput.

jess: We could add a small role context on quota events (eg. role_id or a role_hash) to make grouping easier, but that touches ingestion and increases event size.

rohith: Agree with the risk. Prefer deriving a lightweight `role_snapshot` index in the pipeline that maps principal_id -> role at minute granularity, then join at query time. That keeps core event payloads small.

maria: +1 for derived index. We can store just `{principal, minute_bucket, role_hash}` so storage and join cost are modest. Also retains privacy (no full role blob). :+1:

anya: That would be perfect for canary rollouts — we need to answer "which roles saw the spike" without ad-hoc DB lookups.

sam: On the console side, small UX ask: add a "role context" toggle to per-route dashboards so product teams can flip between global and per-role views. Default to global to avoid breaking saved reports. :eyes:

jess: UX mock: top-right pill "role: All" -> dropdown of tenant roles; when selected it filters queries by `role_snapshot`. Also expose a checkbox "as of time" to do historical lookups.

anya: Example API we could support in telemetry service (rough sketch):
```
GET /telemetry/query?q=quota_usage&group_by=route,role_snapshot&as_of=2025-11-10T15:04:00Z
```
This returns aggregates joined against the role_snapshot index.

rohith: Implementation notes: `as_of` queries should bypass the aggregator cache or use a read-through path that materializes the join. Also need to guard cost — historical joins can be heavy.

maria: Proposal: limit `as_of` to 7d for on-demand joins; longer windows go to background batch jobs that populate a coarser rollup table. We'll document in API.

sam: Ops/rollout plan: feature-flag the role_snapshot indexer per-org. Start telemetry for 10 canary orgs, validate query perf & cost, then flip default. Keep legacy join mode for older orgs.

jess: UX rollout checklist: 1) role selector UI, 2) saved dashboard migration note, 3) sample alert templates ("route quota spike for non-admin roles"), 4) guide for analysts on using `as_of`.

rohith: I'll open the schema PR for `role_snapshot` + indexer code. ETA: EOD today for initial branch. Will include a toggle in org config.

anya: Also: telemetry naming conventions — can we standardize event labels: `quota.usage`, `perm.change.role` so queries and dashboards don't diverge? small taxonomy PR would help.

maria: yes, please add naming doc. We should also add metrics for join cardinality so we can alert on query explosions (eg. when someone groups by full role metadata accidentally).

sam: Good point — add guardrails in the UI: when user groups by role, show estimated cardinality + cost estimate before running heavy query.

jess: UX microcopy: "Grouping by role may increase query cost — try sampling or narrow time range." Small affordance but saves surprises.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-pipeline/role-snapshot-indexer @ci :shipit:

anya: Thanks — if you tag me on the PR I'll test the dashboard flows with our canary org.
